text: ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいりで　しょうぶ　するわ！

structure.jp: ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいりで
structure.en: with the favorite I traded with a friend for

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいり
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. ともだちと こうかん した おきにいり = 'the favorite that I traded with a friend for'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what you use to do something. おきにいりで = 'using my favorite'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, feminine tone. しょうぶ するわ = 'I'll battle!'
